Neon After Rain

CINEMA 4D, OCTANE// ROLE: 3D ARTIST// YEAR: 2026

From concept art to final render.

I wanted a fresh after-rain scene rather than one caught mid-downpour. The original concept art came from my friend Joana Schulte, and I rebuilt it as a realistic render. This was before the era of AI, so every stage took time.

I'm most pleased with the water drops, the wet glass and the puddles.
